name: SoftEdgeFormat
description: Represents the soft edge effect in Office graphics.
remarks: The soft edge effect creates a mask around the edge of an object and blends the object with the transparent edge. The result is a faded or "feathered" edge.
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes(2)
 With .Text.Font
 .Size = 32
 .Name = "Palatino"
 .Softedgeformat = msosoftedge6
 End With
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SoftEdgeFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SoftEdgeFormat object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets or sets the type of the SoftEdgeFormat object. Read/write.

properties.name: Radius
properties.description: Gets or sets the size, measured in points, of the soft edge effect of the shape. Read/write.
